tools.name: analyze-request-tool
tools.description: Evaluates whether The2410 can build the custom software project a customer describes. Use it when a customer describes a new project or request. Returns fit, relevant services or solutions, indicative pricing, a project_context_id and next_actions for the project tools. If the request is only a small task, returns route = small_task and the URL of the separate Human Tasks by The2410 connector. This is not a detailed project plan or a contractual estimate.

project_context_id.description: Omit for a new project. To continue an existing project, send the exact UUID returned by a previous call.

request_description.description: The customer's request as written, in any language: what they need, platform, constraints and main requirements.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code, for example EUR or USD.

desired_timeline.description: Desired delivery timeframe, for example "4-6 months".

tools.name: plan-project-tool
tools.description: Create a preliminary project plan, price range and development effort estimate. Use this tool to understand the main functional modules and important unresolved requirements. Provide an existing project_context_id or a project_description for a new project. Module status describes The2410's proposed solution; confirmed does not mean customer approval. Prices and working days are shares of the existing project estimate. When no published price applies, price and working days are null and a specialist of The2410 names them after the inquiry. This is a preliminary estimate, not a final specification or contractual offer. Building the plan runs a detailed analysis on The2410's side, so the customer's name and email are required. They are saved with the project, and The2410 may contact the customer about it. Phone and company name are optional. The plan can be updated by calling this tool again.

project_context_id.description: Existing project UUID. Required when project_description is omitted.

project_description.description: Required for a new project. Omit or send null to reuse the saved description.

additional_requirements.description: Updated requirements or answers to planning questions. Omit to keep the current ones.

phone.description: Optional phone number. Omit to keep the saved value.

company_name.description: Optional company name. Omit to keep the saved value.

tools.name: find_case_studies
tools.description: Find published The2410 case studies relevant to the customer's current software project. Use this tool when the user wants examples of similar work or relevant project experience. The tool uses the existing project context and returns up to five case studies, ordered by relevance. It does not change the project context, plan, or estimate.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

tools.name: check_delivery_window
tools.description: Check The2410's indicative delivery availability for the customer's software project. Use this tool when the user wants to know when The2410 could start the project and the approximate delivery window. The tool uses the current project context, estimated business days, and the customer's preferred start. Returned dates are indicative and are not a contractual commitment.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

preferred_start.description: For example ASAP, 2026-11, or January 2027. Omit to reuse the stored preference. Send ASAP or null for the earliest available start.

tools.name: prepare-project-inquiry-tool
tools.description: Prepare a project inquiry draft for the customer to review before it is submitted to The2410. Run plan-project-tool first and provide the existing project_context_id. The customer's name and email are required; company and phone are optional. Returns the project fit, offering, estimate and modules with their price and effort. Delivery dates are indicative; if not calculated, the response explains how to request them. The draft can be changed by calling this tool again. This tool does not submit the inquiry, send an email or delete anything.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

contact.description: Customer contact details. Name and email are required; company and phone are optional.

comments.description: Comments for the inquiry draft. Omit to keep the current comments.

tools.name: submit-project-inquiry-tool
tools.description: Submit the customer's project inquiry to The2410 by email. Use this tool after the customer has reviewed the inquiry and explicitly asked to submit it. Provide the existing project_context_id and the reviewed contact details. Name and email are required; company and phone are optional. The tool uses the saved analysis and plan, then emails the inquiry to The2410. It does not send an automatic confirmation email to the customer. Do not repeat this call after a successful submission.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

contact.description: Customer contact details. Name and email are required; company and phone are optional.

comments.description: Inquiry comments. Replaces saved comments. Omit to keep them; null clears them.

tools.name: get_consultation_slots
tools.description: Get available consultation times with The2410 for the current software project. Use this tool when the user wants to speak with The2410 or choose a consultation time. The tool retrieves current calendar availability and returns up to ten slots, ordered from earliest to latest, in the requested timezone. This tool does not reserve a slot or create a booking.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

timezone.description: IANA timezone, for example Europe/Berlin. Defaults to Europe/Riga.

date_from.description: First date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the requested timezone. Defaults to today.

date_to.description: Last date, inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to six days after date_from. Maximum query span: 31 days.

tools.name: book_consultation
tools.description: Register a consultation with The2410 by sending an email to the team. Use this tool after the user selects a slot from the latest get_consultation_slots response and confirms that they want to book it. Provide the customer's name and email. The consultation language is English. The team will send the customer a separate confirmation with the meeting details. Do not submit the same booking again after a successful response.

project_context_id.description: The exact project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.

slot_id.description: The selected slot_id from the latest get_consultation_slots response.

comments.description: Optional comments or topics to discuss during the consultation.

tools.name: send-feedback-tool
tools.description: Send feedback to The2410 team: a problem, a suggestion, praise or any other message about this MCP server, an order or a project. Use only when the customer wants to share feedback. Show the message to the customer and send it after they confirm. Name and email are optional; include them if the customer wants a reply. If the feedback is about a specific project or order, add the project_context_id or order_id returned by an earlier call. Never include passwords, access details or payment card data.

message.description: The feedback text, in the customer's words.

email.description: Optional customer email, if the customer wants a reply.

order_id.description: Optional order id of a fixed-price service order, e.g. ord_8f3k2m9qxa.

project_context_id.description: Optional project context UUID returned by a previous tool call.
